summary: tuning part attached at a ug_* frame: the part's form, mounts that touch the car body, the paint key colour.

overall.summary: the part on the car, 3/4 views

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Part body
items.construction: the main form (spoiler blade, skirt, scoop, pipe) lofted or swept, soft

items.name: Mounts
items.construction: feet or brackets touching the car body at the ug_* frame

items.name: Paint key colour
items.construction: paint faces on the vehicle key colour

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/vehicle_upgrade.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
